_comment: Golden hashes of generateTemplate() output, captured from generation modules byte-identical to base commit 81c802b (verified with `git diff --quiet HEAD -- src/core/generate-template.js src/core/assemble-template.js src/core/sort-policy.js src/core/filter-policy.js`). Proves the pre-flight refinement did not touch generated JSON. See reports/04-refinements-research.md.
_hashScope: Credential-shaped fields (apikey/token/password/secret/passwd/credential, case-insensitive) are stripped before hashing so no credential can flow into a fast digest; CodeQL flagged the previous full-object hash as js/insufficient-password-hash. Those fields are asserted separately and by name in preflight-json-fixture.test.mjs. The pre-strip hashes over the identical output were d7e2938bc8fc7ed7 / ea2ddb65ecd6903b / f1d6f71b3276b2ea / f91821cea7f8d032 and still reproduce exactly, which is what confirms only the hashing scope changed, not the generated JSON.
